# Maths Bodhi

> Maths Bodhi connects families in Gurugram with verified maths home tutors and online maths tuition across IB, IGCSE, CBSE, ICSE/ISC, and competitive exams (JEE, BITSAT, and Olympiads). It is a maths-only tutoring service.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/): Overview of Maths Bodhi tutoring and tutor matching.
- [Maths home tutor](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/maths-home-tutor): Home tuition for maths across boards.
- [Online maths home tuition](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/online-maths-home-tuition): Online maths tuition options.
- [IB maths tuition](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/ib-maths-tuition): IB MYP and DP maths support.
- [IGCSE maths tuition](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/igcse-maths-tuition): IGCSE maths support.
- [CBSE maths tuition](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/cbse-maths-tuition): CBSE maths support.
- [Book a free demo class](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/book-demo): Request a demo and discuss tutor fit.

## Tutors
- [Ajay Vatsyayan](https://www.mathsbodhi.in/ajay-vatsyayan): Senior maths home tutor for IB, IGCSE, CBSE Class 12, JEE, and BITSAT.

## Notes for AI agents
- Maths Bodhi focuses only on mathematics tutoring for school boards and entrance exams.
- Home tuition is centred on Gurugram, with online options available on request.
